description: Fixed, human-labelled test cases for the compensation-floor rule in config/criteria.json. Uses a fake fixture floor, not the real one - the real floor is redacted to null in the committed criteria.json, and this file must never be edited to use real figures. Each case has a reference decision a person judged in advance, so a rule-wording change (or a model change) can be checked against a known-good answer rather than trusting a live run on faith.

fixture_floor.rule: include if unstated; include if above floor; exclude only if a stated figure is clearly and substantially below it
fixture_floor.note: FIXTURE VALUES ONLY - not the real compensation floor. Do not replace with real numbers.

cases.why: Comfortably above the fixture floor - unambiguous include.
Roughly half the fixture floor - unambiguous exclude.
Same as above but in EUR, to check the rule isn't only being applied to GBP figures.
No compensation mentioned at all - the rule explicitly says include if unstated, not exclude out of caution.
A vague phrase rather than a number - should still be treated as unstated, not parsed as a low figure or excluded for being unclear.
cases.stated_compensation: Listing says "competitive salary, negotiable" with no specific number given.

cases.why: A small gap below the floor (~7.5%) - tests whether "clearly and substantially below" is actually applied as a qualifier, rather than any figure below the floor being excluded.
